vs.sub: The character bible of Yasser and Kūro
vs.desc: The founder’s own project, with no client: the bible of a character and his black cat. A twenty-frame rig where Yasser follows your cursor, talks and settles after five seconds, twelve faces, six poses in two beats, ten cards for Kūro, the silhouette in seven rules and the way he talks.
vs.alt: Six of Yasser’s faces from the bible: a sideways smirk, a hand on his glasses, a hand on his chin, a big laugh, a deadpan stare, a suspicious side-eye.

mc.desc: The founder’s own animated-short project, with no client, in two acts. Yasser, a gentleman thief in a black three-piece suit, bows on the stage of a Belle Époque theatre. His suit unfolds into a red traveller’s outfit, then his companions arrive: Kūro the black cat in a red scarf, a raven on his shoulder, a techno pigeon and Ratman the rat in his satchel. The white curtains open on a cobalt moon.
mc.lang: Act 2 · 10 s · silent, press play yourself
mc.framesLabel: Nine key frames, from the entrance to the final close-up
frames: Yasser as the gentleman, in a black three-piece suit and hat, walking across a theatre stage under great dark wings.
Yasser in a black suit and hat walks on stage in a spotlight beam, in front of dark curtains.
Yasser bows, hat in hand, a gold coin above the hat, in the spotlight’s golden circle.
Yasser leans into a bow, hat raised, a gold coin in the air, in front of a golden curtain.
Mid-transformation: the black suit unfolds into red flames around Yasser, one arm raised towards a gold coin and the cobalt moon.
The black coat opens onto its red lining: Yasser mid-change, a raven flying in, a techno pigeon above, Kūro at his feet.
Yasser in the red traveller’s outfit tosses the coin, with Kūro the cat, a raven, a techno pigeon and Ratman around him, under the moon.
The final tableau: Yasser in red, a raven on his shoulder, Ratman in his satchel, Kūro at his feet, in front of white curtains and the moon.
Final close-up: Yasser in the red traveller’s outfit catches the gold coin, the raven on his shoulder; below, Kūro and Ratman before the moon and the golden city.
mc.video: Act 2 of MERCURY in ten seconds: Yasser in the red traveller’s outfit, with Kūro, the raven, the techno pigeon and Ratman, in front of the moon.
